subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**core**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given passage, the blank 3 refers to the central part of the body that is included during exercise.**
 
• Now, among the given options, the appropriate word to use in blank 3 is "core."(अन्तर्भाग)
 
• **"Core" refers to the central or most important part of something**.
 
 
• Your core is the central part of your body. It includes your pelvis, lower back, hips and stomach.
 
• Example: Core exercises train the muscles in your core to work in harmony.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "spot", refers to a small area or location.(स्थान)
 
• Option 3, "space", refers to an area or volume that is empty or available.(जगह)
 
• Option 4, "matter", refers to physical substance or material.(पदार्थ)

1f9:Ta6a,
